findings.title: SectionIntro job-description link is an <a> with no href/tabIndex — not keyboard-focusable; the adjudicated conventions-pass focus ring on it is unreachable CSS and the section's only inline navigation affordance cannot be reached or activated by keyboard
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC §8.3: "'job description' is an inline link" navigating via props.history.push (router-prop pattern per OrganizationAiUsage.tsx:17-19 — whose clickable element is a focusable Button); conventions-pass fix 8 (adjudicated, commit 9ed954142): focus ring on JobCriteriaSection SectionIntro `a` per ui_styling.md rule 6 ("Always include hover and focus states")
findings.evidence: app/javascript/ats/src/views/jobApplications/jobSetup/components/JobCriteriaSection.tsx:39 — ` history.push(...)}>job description` has no `href` and no `tabIndex`, so the browser never places it in the tab order: keyboard users cannot reach or activate the link, and the `&:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: ... }` rule added at lines 195-198 to satisfy the adjudicated conventions fix can never match (dead CSS — the element cannot receive focus). This is not an established codebase pattern: a grep of ats/src finds ZERO other `` without href; the spec's cited analog (OrganizationAiUsage.tsx:44, `
findings.recommendation: Make the anchor focusable and keyboard-activatable: give it `href={`/jobs/${job.id}/setup/description`}` with `onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); history.push(...); }}` (preserves SPA navigation, gains focusability, real href for a11y), or use react-router `Link`, or add `tabIndex={0}` + an Enter/Space key handler. Any of these makes the existing focus ring functional.

spec_coverage.notes: STATE-MACHINE WALK (actual code conditionals, JobCriteriaSection.tsx:43-82): (a) never-ran: status null -> neverExtracted EmptyState + 'Generate criteria'; click opens RegenerateJobCriteriaConfirmModal (spec routes BOTH labels through the same modal, §8.3); confirm POST -> hook-level invalidateQueries -> isFetching true -> button loading with no gap -> refetch lands status pending -> isPayloadStatusInFlight -> WS complete -> toast + invalidate -> succeeded card. (b) succeeded -> Regenerate: in-flight renders old card + enabled View button + loading/disabled Regenerate ('card' branch at line 72-73); zero-criteria failure lands -> zeroCriteria EmptyState replaces old card (adjudicated flag 5). (c) failed-other -> Regenerate -> in-flight renders neverExtracted underneath with 'Generate criteria' label per §8.2 'state 1 layered over state 5' (rows 2-3 unreachable under in-flight, exactly as specced) -> succeeds -> card. (d) query 500 -> isError early return, no action buttons (adjudicated conventions fix 4) — only dead-end state, recovery is page refresh per its own message. (e) reload mid-extraction: isLoading -> LoadingIndicator -> payload in-flight -> button loading (survives reload, backend-status-driven per DECISIONS). WS-MISSED STALENESS: no polling, refetchOnWindowFocus:false app-wide (App.tsx:20-26), so if the WS event never arrives the button spins for the life of the mounted view; RECOVERY EXISTS: navigating away/back remounts (react-query refetchOnMount default true -> refetch resolves per backend status) and full reload recovers — matches §8.2 row 1 'survives reload' semantics; noting per dispatch, not a finding. ISINFLIGHT DERIVATION: code (lines 65-69) is verbatim plan D-5; isFetching fires on initial load (masked by isLoading early return), post-POST invalidation window (the intended clause), WS-invalidation refetch (masked — stale payload still shows in-flight during it), and remount background refetch (brief cosmetic flash, explicitly adjudicated as accepted cost in Reviewed Plan D-5/R-3 — not re-flagged); no window-focus refetches (global default false); no other WS case invalidates this key. MODAL CHAIN: dismissModalWithAnimation(() => onCancel) verified against ModalContext.tsx:47-63 — the double-wrap counteracts React setState updater semantics (setAnimationCompleteCallback(fn) stores fn's return value, i.e. removeModal itself), CenterModal onDestroyed -> animationCompleteCallback() -> removeModal; identical to analog BulkGenerateAiSummariesConfirmModal.tsx:53/91. Confirm button loading+disabled from LIVE internal hook state (rule 22 satisfied); jobId/onCancel are the only frozen props (static/stable — safe); NO state-derived prop (isInFlight etc.) passed into either modal; View modal frozen criteria = adjudicated accepted. Section button adds disabled={isInFlight} beyond §8.3's literal loading={...} — traceable to SPEC §4.1 ('The frontend disables the button once the payload shows an in-flight status') and necessary because Button/index.js:33 blocks clicks only via disabled, not loading. Minor inherited quirk (analog-identical, not a finding): if the user Esc-closes the confirm mid-mutation and opens the View modal before POST resolves, onSuccess's dismissModalWithAnimation will close whatever modal is then open. COUNT RAIL / TIER EDGES: unknown tier values are impossible upstream — Call 2 uses a strict JSON schema with enum tier_1/tier_2/tier_3 (job_description_criteria_extraction.rb:238-241) and the heading override writes only tier_1/tier_3, so the filter-based counts cannot silently drop rows; criteria=[] with status succeeded (spec-impossible) renders the card without crash (empty array is truthy): Core 0 / Preferred 0, Bonus row hidden, View modal opens with an empty bordered ListBox — degenerate but non-crashing; 0-core/0-preferred/only-bonus renders Core 0 + Preferred 0 + Bonus n per spec (only tier_3 row is conditional, line 104). LINK/ROUTE: /jobs/${id}/setup/description verified as a real route chain — AppContainer.tsx:146 (/jobs/:jobId) -> JobStagesContainer.tsx:180 (match.path + /setup) -> JobSetupContainer.tsx:442-447 (match.path + /description); history verified available: JobSetupContainer.tsx:484-489 passes Route renderProps into JobSetupAiSettings, which passes props.history to JobCriteriaSection (JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107).
